title: High quality
text: High quality. This sheet set is warm and cozy and very attractive.  It has a wide elasticized edge that fits snuggly around the mattress.  This is high quality, heavy duty material I expect to last for a good long time.

product_metadata.title: Pointehaven Heavy Weight Flannel Cotton Sheet Set, Queen, Plaid Sage
features: Fabric: Double Brushed Cotton Flannel with velvet feel - Oeko-Tex Certification: Made in Green certification from Oeko-Tex. Tested for harmful substances and produced sustainably in accordance with Oeko-Tex guidelines.
Extra size: Oversized flat sheet and pillow cases. Fitted Sheet fits up to 18" Mattress and has elastic all around
European closure on the pillow cases: The pillowcase have a flap on one side so the pillow hides under the flap and is not visible from the pillowcase opening.
Easy care - Made of fine material that holds up to repeated washing. Washing Instructions: Please see sewn-in care label for care instructions.
Set Includes: Queen dimensions: flat sheet: 90-inch by 104-inch - fitted sheet: 60-inch by 80-inch fits mattresses up to 16-inch deep; pillowcases: 21-inch by 31-inch
description: Rest well in cozy heavy weight flannel comfort with this super soft cotton sheet set. These sheets come in your choice of solid colors or prints to add the perfect accent to any bedroom decor. Conveniently machine washable for easy care, this set is perfect for every day use.
